% A pgfplots chart in a cmyk-option document: axes, grid, a line, bars.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[cmyk]{xcolor}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[width=7cm,height=5cm,grid=major,xlabel={x},ylabel={y}]
  \addplot[blue,thick] coordinates {(0,0) (1,2) (2,1) (3,3)};
  \addplot[ybar,fill=red!60] coordinates {(0,1) (1,1.5) (2,2) (3,2.5)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
